outputs.explanation: Panel A consists only of micrographs (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker, Merge images); no bar/summary plot is present, so the check does not apply.
Panel B includes micrographs plus two bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity) showing group means with error bars (n=20). No individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel C is a Western blot image only; it does not contain a quantification plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel D includes micrographs (SDH, COX staining) plus two bar charts of signal intensity showing means with error bars (N indicated in bars). No individual data points are overlaid.

Panel E shows FACS histogram plots (cell counts vs. TMRM intensity) for each of three independent replicates displayed separately; these are raw distribution/line-type plots rather than bar charts of averages, so overlaying individual points is not applicable.
